# vyos.blueprints.router_advert

IPv6 router advertisements

- Sends router advertisements on LAN interfaces so hosts configure addresses with SLAAC and learn DNS servers (RDNSS).
- Configured with vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no router-advert module.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.router_advert
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `router_advert_interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Interfaces to advertise on. Nothing is configured when empty. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.name` | str | yes |  | LAN interface, e.g. `eth1`. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.link_mtu` | int |  |  | MTU to advertise, e.g. `1492` behind PPPoE. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.name_servers` | list |  | `[]` | DNS servers to advertise. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.prefixes` | list |  | `[]` | Prefixes to advertise; `::/64` means any /64 on the interface. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.prefixes.prefix` | str | yes |  | Prefix, e.g. `::/64`. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.prefixes.valid_lifetime` | int |  |  | Valid lifetime in seconds. |
| `router_advert_interfaces.prefixes.preferred_lifetime` | int |  |  | Preferred lifetime in seconds. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |
